title: Notion says Fireworks AI breach exposed some customers' Notion AI chat transcripts
summary: Notion is notifying a small set of customers that Notion AI chat transcripts used for its Insights feature were accessed when inference provider Fireworks AI was breached on October 24 through a third-party cloud host. Fireworks told Notion on November 2. Fewer than 1% of workspaces were affected and most transcripts cannot be tied to a customer. Notion advises rotating any credentials pasted into Notion AI.
plain: Hackers who broke into an AI company Notion used got copies of some Notion AI chats. Notion says under 1% of workspaces were affected and is contacting them.
exec: AI inference providers are now part of the data supply chain; prompts and chat logs held by them carry breach risk.
action: If Notion contacted you, review the exposed transcripts and rotate any passwords, API keys or credentials that were pasted into Notion AI; ask your AI vendors where prompt data is processed and retained.

validation.note: SecurityWeek report quoting Notion's customer notice; related Fireworks AI events are on file.

links.rel: customer data exposed in supplier breach

review.note: Compared Oct 24 breach, Nov 2 notice, under 1% of workspaces, Insights transcripts and credential-rotation advice against SecurityWeek (Nov 12)
